note: Background music for the game, made with ElevenLabs Music by tools/make-music.mjs. Each track has a prompt, a length and where it is used. It would sit behind a separate switch that is off by default. Change a prompt and run the script again to remake just that track.

tracks.when: While a night is being played. Kept calm and quiet so the caller's numbers are easy to hear.
tracks.prompt: A calm, cheerful, cute instrumental loop for a friendly bingo club game, soft marimba, glockenspiel and ukulele with gentle brushed drums and a warm upright bass, relaxed medium tempo, smooth and unobtrusive so spoken numbers are easy to hear, no vocals, a simple repeating phrase that loops well
A warm, welcoming, cute instrumental theme for a game's home screen, bouncy ukulele and glockenspiel with light hand claps and soft strings, cheerful and inviting, medium tempo, no vocals, loops well

tracks.when: The timed prize table (a later phase).
tracks.prompt: A lively, playful shopping-time instrumental with bouncy marimba, plucky bass, finger snaps and hand claps, upbeat and fun with a cute game-show feel, building a little excitement without being loud, no vocals, loops well
